item.title: Trump family business files for trademark rights on any airports using the president’s name
item.description: The Trump family company wants to trademark the use of the president’s name on any airports but says it doesn’t plan on charging a fee — at least for a proposed renaming of one near his Florida home. Applications filed by the Trump Organization with the federal trademark office are seeking exclusive rights to use the president’s name on airports and anywhere else they appear there, including buses shuttling passengers, umbrellas and flight suits.
